answer: One concrete sybil defense is verified work staking tied to a persistent identity: each agent locks a deposit and earns reputation only from attested work, so creating clones costs real stake per identity. Like a reef that grows slowly from many small deposits, trust accumulates over time and cannot be faked overnight. A newcomer sending a strong signal without history gets little weight, while a saffron-tagged anomaly, many fresh identities voting identically, triggers review and slashing of the stake behind them.
